rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for the fastener on clothing, bags, and similar items.

example.english: The zip on your backpack isn't closed properly.
example.traditional: 你個背囊條拉鍊未拉好喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 go3 bui3 nong4 tiu4 laai1 lin2 mei6 laai1 hou2 wo3

rows.note: Use this for literal zero or, more loosely, nothing at all; idiomatic sentences such as “know zip about” usually need a different Cantonese sentence.

example.english: I got zip points for my homework.
example.jyutping: ngo5 fan6 gung1 fo3 lo2 zo2 ling4 fan1

rows.note: Use this for a digital file compressed into a ZIP archive, rather than for a physical zip or the number zero.

example.english: Please send me the photos as a zip file.
example.traditional: 你將啲相打包成壓縮檔先傳畀我啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 zoeng1 di1 soeng1 daa2 baau1 sing4 aat3 suk1 dong2 sin1 cyun4 bei2 ngo5 laa1
